comments.author: tipsystatistic
comments.body:
My kid was playing Magic Tiles, a popular music rhythm game. Each time you fail you had to watch a 60 second ad. Sometimes they'll just replay the same ad for 60s.

I said screw it, I'll just buy it. BUT they wanted a subscription.

Claude!

Claude built it in 20 min. I can give it any song I want and It uses Demucs to separate vocals, instruments and percussion, the automatically places the tiles based on rhythm or vocals

comments.author: couldgiveaflyingfck
comments.body: This is really neat! I'm working on a game for my girlfriend's 10-year-old daughter who's mad about swimming. I snapped some pics, ran them through an AI for a pixel art makeover, and now she's swimming with her pet dog, Chow Chow, in a bubble helmet, surrounded by seahorses and fish. They're on a treasure hunt, and it's shaping up to be a fun, personalized experience. I dig what you're doing here, and I think we'll see more of this in the future.

comments.author: Pixelzonty
comments.body: This is so wholesome.  I'm making a strategy game currently though my son is only 6 and he doesn't know how to play.  I started a little cars game with basic physics and at least once a week he wants to play it with me and tells me to work harder and more on the car game and not the "stat-tree-gy" game.  I know that feeling your feeling and it's one of the best in the world.  I'm very happy for you!
